A '''power station''' was located in the [[Network Access]] area of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the power station was overrun by [[Vrblther/Legends|vrblther]]s.<ref name="TOR:HotV" />
